page.overview:
Who is Reyland family?

The Reylands are a family of merchants who are featured as characters in the television program Mortal Kombat: Conquest.

Baron Reyland, is a wealthy owner of a trading post within the fictional city of Zhu Zin, along with and his daughter Geneviere Reyland, also known as Jen Reyland. Baroness Reyland, the Baron's wife and Jen's mother, is not mentioned. After the Baron and his daughter Jen are killed by Scorpion their trading post is passed on to Kung Lao. The Baron, while portraying himself as a wealthy merchant was actuality deep in debt to the Black Dragons.
